cases.prompt: File this new epic on the board, set its priority field to the repository's documented default, and leave promotion to the owner's rule.
cases.note: A priority or horizon field is optional and repository-declared; agents use its documented default and promotion rule.

cases.prompt: File an agent issue for a possible future bottleneck. No failure, contradiction, user event or review finding has happened; we merely think it might become slow.
cases.note: Refuse to file without an observed event and resolvable evidence. Speculation and an agent approving its own suggestion do not establish readiness.

cases.prompt: A review found an actual access-grant mismatch. Search before filing it, record agent provenance and move it to Ready yourself immediately.
cases.note: Search, cite the finding, check the advisory cap, use source:agent from the synced declaration and an actual Filed-by trailer. Leave readiness to an independent authorised triager; never self-approve.

cases.prompt: Bulk edits refreshed every updatedAt value. A referenced PR has merged and an issue dependency has closed. Decide which issues need re-verification.
cases.note: Use content changes to select re-verification; neither old age nor a fresh timestamp establishes staleness or completion.

cases.prompt: The declared Ready cap is full. File every planned checklist-epic leaf now even though no writer has leased any of them.
cases.note: Pause filing at the advisory cap. Keep unleased plans in the epic; create or reuse one leaf per live task on lease and use native sub-issue links once it exists.
